findings.found: The gap said not listed. Newegg lists the exact fan (P14 PWM PST, black, single) under the ARCTIC brand.
findings.fix: Priced from that Newegg listing (USD 27.79) with a capture; the gap is removed.

findings.found: The gap said not-listed. Amazon US lists the current WDS100T5B0A as "Currently unavailable", with no price.
findings.fix: reasonCode set to unavailable; the reason names that listing.

batches.followUp: Every US gap was re-checked. The Vulcan Z gap now names the other TeamGroup code Amazon lists, and gap codes now prefer a listed state (unavailable, no-price-shown) over not-listed.

batches.method: Each observation read against its saved live page under artifacts/prices/<market>/ (sha256-checked): the exact part, the buy-box amount as displayed, the seller and the stock state (log: prices-pass1.txt).

findings.found: The displayed SAR 82.75 includes estimated import charges (item SAR 56.96 plus SAR 25.79) on a global-store offer. The record did not say so.
findings.fix: A note on amount gives the import-charge split. The amount stays as displayed.

findings.found: The note called the offer "far above launch pricing", which no source in the record supports.
findings.fix: The note keeps to what the page says: a third-party offer that usually ships in 10 to 11 days.

batches.followUp: The 8 other global-store offers in SA got the same import-charge note, and the same unsupported wording was removed from the US observation of the RTX 5080 Founders Edition.

findings.found: The gap said Amazon.sa lists only the earlier WDS100T3B0A. An imported Amazon.sa offer of the current WDS100T5B0A was on sale.
findings.fix: Priced from that offer (SAR 1,103.78, import charges included) with a capture; the gap is removed.

batches.followUp: Every SA gap was re-checked. The Core Ultra 9 285K is now priced, the TUF RTX 5070 Ti gap is now unavailable (the exact card is listed as "Currently unavailable"), and the Vulcan Z gap names the other TeamGroup code.

findings.found: The locator cites the bar as "Ryzen 7 9850X3D (stock)"; the chart reads "Ryzen 7 9850X3D / Stock".
findings.fix: The locator quotes the chart label exactly. No value changed.

findings.found: The locator rewrites the chart title ("2560 x 1440", a hyphen); the page reads "2.560 × 1.440" with an en dash, so a search of the page finds nothing.
findings.fix: The locator quotes the chart title exactly. No value changed.

batches.followUp: The same fixes went to the unsampled rows: the fourth 9850X3D locator (Cyberpunk 2077) and the other 66 ComputerBase locators. All 80 ComputerBase rows were re-read against the chart HTML; every value matches.
